summary:
ORBITAL IS is an astronaut health-monitoring web application designed to support crew members during long-duration space missions. It guides astronauts through simple, step-by-step health check-ups, recording important indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose, sleep, mood and symptoms.
It records key health details, tracks changes and provides clear health summaries. It addresses the challenge by making health monitoring simple and helping identify possible concerns early. This is important because it helps astronauts and medical teams make better decisions, especially when medical help is far away.
details: ORBITALIS gives crew members a simple way to record and review their physical condition while travelling in space. Users enter health readings and daily information, allowing the application to show patterns and highlight unusual changes. It aims to improve awareness, support timely medical attention and reduce the risk of overlooked health problems. We built it using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, focusing on a clean interface that is easy to navigate. The main creative idea is bringing several health-tracking functions into one platform. Our team considered the effects of weightlessness, communication delays, limited medical resources, ease of use and the need to protect personal health information.
